evidence.source: Shuowen.org, 《說文解字》 entry 書, with 段玉裁 commentary
evidence.text: The entry gives 書 as “箸也。从聿者聲” (“to set down/write; from 聿, with 者 as phonetic”). 段玉裁 connects the gloss with writing on bamboo and silk and says that requires a brush. This is the traditional lexicographic analysis; it does not independently establish the graph’s earliest form or the semantic history of every later sense.
evidence.title: 說文解字「書」 - Shuowen.org

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.text: The entry discusses an old form recorded in the 《說文》 tradition and later dictionaries, and distinguishes seal-derived and clerical transformations in forms related to 書. It notes that the main current standard form is 書. Its listed paleographic source tables include several items marked unavailable, so this page does not supply a complete dated sequence.
evidence.title: [A01835] 書 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.text: States that 书 is the simplification of 書 and describes the change as regularizing a cursive form into standard script. This supports the direction 書 → 书 and the classification simplified_form; the entry does not date the first use of the simplified shape.
evidence.title: 书 - 维基词典

evidence.source: Unicode Consortium, UAX #38, Unicode Han Database
evidence.text: Describes Unihan as a character property database and explains that its reading properties provide readings that vary by language, region and period. It defines kMandarin as a reading property, not as evidence for ancient phonetic relationships. The exact per-character Unihan lookup pages for 書 and 书 could not be accessed in this session.
evidence.title: Unicode Standard Annex #38: Unicode Han Database (Unihan)

evidence.text: The file page labels the graphic as a Shuowen seal-script form and presents links to other script categories. Its page did not establish the specimen's independent dating or paleographic provenance, and the SVG itself could not be opened by the browser. It is therefore not used here as direct visual evidence for a graphic-development sequence.
evidence.title: File:書-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.source: Baxter and Sagart, Old Chinese: A New Reconstruction; supplied local table row
evidence.text: The supplied local Baxter–Sagart table row for 書 reads MC syo and OC *s-ta, gloss “write” (source_path baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv, row for 書). This notation is retained as provided. No local row for 者 was supplied, so this dataset cannot establish the phonetic comparison between 者 and 書 here. The cited book establishes the reconstruction system and its scope, but the accessible page does not provide these character rows.
evidence.title: Old Chinese: A New Reconstruction

evidence.source: Local Unihan readings supplied in task packet; Unicode UAX #38 for database context
evidence.text: The task packet supplies exact local kMandarin rows for both 書 and 书 as shū (source_path sources/unihan/Unihan_Readings.txt). These rows agree with the dossier’s current Mandarin reading, but the official character-specific Unicode pages required for click-through confirmation could not be accessed. The current reading is not evidence of an ancient sound relationship.

gaps: No inspected primary paleographic catalogue provided securely dated earliest attestations of 書 or a dated sequence of its bronze, manuscript, seal and clerical forms. Do not infer these dates from general script chronology or the available seal-image label.

The Shuowen analysis supports 聿 as semantic and 者 as phonetic in traditional lexicography. The supplied local Baxter–Sagart row covers 書 only; no independently checked 者 pronunciation row was available, so the proposed phonetic sound relationship is not quantified here.

The semantic path from writing/setting down to document, letter, text and book is not established chronologically by the inspected evidence. These senses should be reported as uses, without ordering them by dictionary gloss sequence.

The exact official Unicode Unihan pages for 書 (U+66F8) and 书 (U+4E66) were attempted but inaccessible. Local kMandarin rows are identified as task-supplied local data, not externally verified character records.
The source file page for 書-seal.svg was inspected, but its image did not open and its page metadata does not establish independent date or provenance. No visual claim is made.
No bulk reuse permission or editorial case for a local extract was verified; cite character-specific pages rather than mirror source material.
